heading: Repealed. Pub. L. 88–448, title IV, § 402(a)(26), Aug. 19, 1964, 78 Stat. 494

notes.text: Section, act Apr. 21, 1948, ch. 224, § 3, 62 Stat. 197, related to employment of retired Army officers in Remount Service.

notes.heading: Effective Date of Repeal
notes.text: Repeal effective on first day of first month which begins later than ninetieth day following Aug. 19, 1964, see section 403 of Pub. L. 88–448.
